general: Jungle guide with no lane matchups. Elise is a ganker rather than a farmer: run a short three-camp clear and reach the scuttle crab around 2:55 for river vision, which also sets up a level 3 dive on an overextended laner. Only full clear when no lane is gankable, grabbing a scuttle afterward if possible. Her strengths are burst, tower dives with Rappel and early snowballing; ganks depend on landing Cocoon. She is squishy, feast-or-famine and weak late, so press the early lead and contest every dragon and epic objective; with faelights, plan gank paths that avoid the watched river entrances.
